## Problem

Describe the user or maintainer problem this change addresses.

## Change

Explain the smallest relevant behavior change and any compatibility impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] `npm run build --prefix wiki` when wiki files changed
- [ ] `Default` still preserves native model resolution
- [ ] The parent Pi session model is unchanged
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, prompts, sessions, logs, or real configuration

## Notes

List known limitations, follow-up work, or screenshots when they help review the change.
